    How Sellio World works

    Walk
    Tap the ground and your hero walks there. A long way off, they jog. WASD or the arrow keys work too, and Shift runs.
    Look around
    Drag to turn the view. Pinch or scroll to zoom. Q and E turn it from the keyboard.
    Get around
    Sellio Plaza sits in the middle and each street starts at its arch. Open the Map to hop to any street.
    Visit a shop
    Tap a stall or storefront, or walk up and use the button that appears.
    Collect coins
    Walk over coins. Each is worth 1 or 2, and new ones drop in as you go. Your first visit to each shop each day adds 2, and today's goals add more.
    Your hero
    Switch hero any time with the Hero button. Hair, outfits and accessories come with the wardrobe.
    Style your stall
    Every stall on Pop-up Street wears Sellio's purple and white awning, and every business Sellio's orange and white. Spend coins on your signboard, lights and decor, and try an item on before you unlock it.

    This is a preview. Coins and unlocks are kept in this browser only. In Sellio, the server will award and track every coin.
